name: Worldwide generalized bathymetric contours
sourceTitle: GEBCO Earth Relief 2025 at 06 arc minutes
sourceDescription: Reduced by Gaussian Cartesian filtering (31.5 km fullwidth) from GEBCO_2025.nc [GEBCO Bathymetric Compilation Group, 2025 GEBCO 2025 Grid; https://doi.org/10.5285/37c52e96-24ea-67ce-e063-7086abc05f29]
license: Public domain, source attribution required by GEBCO terms
attribution: GEBCO Compilation Group (2025); generalized by GMT; contours derived by AIS Vessel Tracker
limitations: Generalized overview, not the original 15 arc-second grid
Variable survey coverage; grid includes inferred/interpolated depths
No derived contours above Web Mercator latitude limits
Mediterranean detailed contours remain sourced separately from EMODnet
